# Claritev Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results


Claritev Corporation reports financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


*Q3* *2026 Revenues of $268.3 million grew 9.1% compared to Q3 2025*


*Net Loss of $61.8 million*


*Adjusted EBITDA of $162.0 million increased 4.4% compared to Q3 2025* *(Adjusted EBITDA Margin of 60.4% versus 63.1% in Q3 2025)*


**MCLEAN, VA** — November 9, 2026 — Claritev Corporation (“Claritev” or the “Company”) (NYSE: CTEV), a technology, data and insights company focused on making healthcare more affordable, transparent and fair for all, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


[Read the Full Press Release](https://investors.claritev.com/financial-information/quarterly-results)
